$description: What is enforced vs convention for tokens and copy.
rawValues: Forbidden in contracts and PageSpecs. PageSpecs carry no style fields at all: styling is owned by section contracts, which reference semantic/component tokens.
overrides: None. There is no per-instance token-override mechanism in the PageSpec schema, so there is nothing to override or validate at the PageSpec layer.
fonts: Only Fraunces (display), Inter (text/UI) and Rethink Sans 600 (one press-kit heading), all SIL OFL via Google Fonts. The original site's commercial faces are not licensed and must not be used, named as substitutes or requested.
copyBudgetRule: maxWords = longest observed instance of that field in the clone's Kestrel copy + 20% headroom (at least +1 word). Observed counts and the location of each longest instance are in extraction/measured-values.json copyBudgets.
itemCountRule: maxItems = observed maximum item count in the clone's data for that list (no headroom).
